Allow Decomp Buddy To Install Games
Android asks before any app installs other apps. On the next screen, turn on “Allow from this source”, then come back here and Decomp Buddy will carry on.
Allow Decomp Buddy To Place Game Files

This game looks for its files in a folder on your device\'s storage, outside Decomp Buddy. To put them there for you, Android needs your OK on the next screen (“Allow access to manage all files”). Decomp Buddy only writes the files you pick.
To do it by hand: copy your file into the “%1$s” folder on your device\'s internal storage.

Decomp Buddy is made by Maddie at Tanooki Studios. It sets up fan-made Android ports of console games you already own, straight on your phone or handheld. It\'s free, with no ads, no tracking and no account.
